message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to mortgage properties or declare bankruptcy to cover the $450 rent owed to player p4.

St. Charles Place and States Avenue mortgage for only $70 each, which is too little to cover the $87 shortfall. I need a property that mortgages for at least $100.

Pennsylvania Railroad, Tennessee Avenue, Indiana Avenue, and Illinois Avenue each mortgage for enough cash. I will choose the least strategically important property to cover the shortfall. I should avoid mortgaging the pink set, since Virginia is needed to complete it.

I have the complete red set: Tennessee, Indiana, and Illinois. Player p4 owns a light blue monopoly with four houses each and several other properties.

The red monopoly is extremely valuable with zero houses. I will mortgage a property other than the red set to cover the shortfall.

Mortgaging any red property would prevent building on the set. I will mortgage Pennsylvania Railroad for $100, leaving $13 cash after paying the rent.
